---
title: "Workflows and outputs"
format: html
---

Maintained scripts under
[`examples/workflows/`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblr/tree/master/examples/workflows)
cover ST summary and individual models, annotations, MT mixtures,
`selection_s`, convergence, selected markers, and operator comparison.

All fits identify `family`, public `model`, and `operator`. `input` contains
resolved controls and prior/effect-scale policies; `data` owns marker/trait
order, scales, sample sizes, and provenance. `model_parameters`, `diagnostics`,
`convergence`, `convergence_traces`, `chains`, and `memory_estimate` have
distinct responsibilities.

`bm` is posterior mean effective effect and `b_final` is final effective state.
`dm` is posterior binary activity/non-null probability and `d_final` is final
binary activity. Latent `beta_final` and mixture `component_final` appear only
where defined. `component_probabilities` are posterior allocation
probabilities, not annotation-driven priors.

Trait traces `vbs`, `vgs`, `ves`, `vle`, and `vld` are iteration × trait.
MT covariance outputs are full trait × trait mean/final matrices. Global
probability fields distinguish final, posterior mean, and trace states; MT
BayesRC uses explicit pattern and annotation fields instead of redefining
`pi_*`.

Posterior means pool retained samples across chains; primary chain 1 owns final
mutable state. Use `keep_chains` for compact task records and
`convergence_control$keep_traces` for formal diagnostic arrays. These controls
are independent. The complete schema is in the
[developer output contract](../dev/blr_output_schema.md).
